# Francesco Colombo: full profile

> Software engineer living in the Toulouse countryside. Focused on financial crime technology, sustainability, and simple systems.

## Professional background

At Monzo Bank since 2016. Initially worked in customer support, then focused on Anti-Money Laundering (AML), financial crime, and fraud investigation, supported by ICA qualifications. Subsequently transitioned into software engineering, building internal tools and systems that help investigators handle complex fraud cases reported by customers.

Day-to-day engineering involves modern web and backend technologies, including React, TypeScript and Go, within large-scale distributed systems.

Before moving into technology, worked as a local journalist, developing an investigative mindset and an appreciation for clear, straightforward communication.

## Personal philosophy and lifestyle

Based in the countryside near Toulouse, France. Drawn to simplicity, thoughtful choices, and things built to last: buying less, avoiding waste, and enjoying the slower pace of rural life.

## Site architecture

A minimalist, performance-focused static website built with plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, without frameworks or external dependencies. Uses a system font stack, avoiding third-party font requests and unnecessary network connections.

Available in English, Italian, and French, with manual language switching and automatic dark/light theme detection.
